text: Soon after [a Japanese stranger arrives in Gokseong|origin|strangers who arrive], a small village in the mountains of South Korea, [a bizarre infection|threat|sickness and poison] drives villagers to kill their own families. Police officer Jong-goo searches the stranger's house and finds [a shrine of photographs and belongings of the dead|images|pictures, screens and recordings], among them a shoe belonging to his daughter Hyo-jin, who is now falling ill herself. A shaman, a deacon and a mysterious young woman each name a different demon, and Jong-goo must choose whom to trust before [the rooster crows a third time|rules|break the rule and pay].
